question: Which state is famous for Dandiya-ras dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gujarat.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Dandiya Raas is the folk dance of Gujarat.__
 
• It is the socio-religious folk dance of Gujarat.
 
• It performed popularly at Navaratri Festival.
 
• Kapila Vatsyayan argued that Rasa's theory of esthetics gives the Indian arts the underlying unity.
 
• The popular forms of Raas include Dandiya Raas, Gopgunthan Solanga Raas, and Mer Dandiya Raas.</s
